title: Seed length from generator size
statement: Let $n,d,\ell$ be natural numbers with $n>0$ and $\ell\neq0$, and let $\varepsilon>0$. For the small-bias generator formed from pairs in the degree-$\ell$ extension field of $\mathbb F_2$, suppose the cardinality of its output multiset is at most $16\bigl(n/B(\varepsilon,d)\bigr)^2$, where $B(\varepsilon,d)=(\varepsilon/9)^{2^{d-1}}$. Then its seed length $2d\ell$ is at most $d\bigl(4+2(\log_2 n+2^{d-1}\log_2(9/\varepsilon))\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: The generator multiset cardinality is at most $16(n/B(\varepsilon,d))^2$
